findings.text: Module load entry validates caller privilege, copies the user image into kernel scratch, accounts copy failures in read error statistics, then runs the common load pipeline with default flags and returns its status.

Load reserves a module in unformed state, publishes it as coming after hardening, then either runs init or demotes to going on failure. Teardown unlinks from list and address tree, wakes waiters, waits for readers, restores protections and frees memory, with distinct paths for pre allocation versus post allocation failure.

Signature handling and ELF sanity precede blacklist, section rewrite, layout version and info checks. Only after those succeed is permanent layout allocated, audited and reserved, so malformed or forbidden images never reach global visibility.

Uniqueness is enforced patiently at reservation and again while becoming, and exported symbol duplication is verified during formation. All three checks run with the module list lock held so concurrent loads serialize.

Formation hardens regions in order read only data, non executable data, then read only executable text with execution memory restore when already marked. Any hardening failure cleans debug state and aborts formation without publishing as coming.

After formation the loader enables tracing, notifies livepatch of coming, then issues a robust coming versus going notification. A veto converts to an error and triggers the livepatch going notification, preventing half published state.

If version info is intact and a trailing marker is present the length is truncated and the truncated image is cryptographically verified. Missing, unsupported crypto and unavailable key outcomes are tolerated unless signature enforcement or lockdown rejects them, while all other verification errors fail the load.

Before the embedded module structure is trusted the loader requires the in kernel layout symbol to be present under a read side critical section and requires its checksum to agree. Absence is treated as an internal bug and mismatch rejects execution format.

Argument parsing uses a custom unknown parameter hook that consumes a boolean async probe request with true as fallback, delegates dynamic debug magic, and otherwise warns and ignores. Tokens after the separator are warned about and ignored rather than failing the load.

System directory publication creates the module object, holders directory, parameter files, info attributes, usage links, section group and notes group in that order. Each failure unwinds only the steps already completed in reverse order.

Loaded ELF sections are exposed as a sections group with per section read attributes sized for bounded reads, and note sections as a notes group reusing section names. When no notes exist setup succeeds trivially and configurations without support compile both helpers to immediate success.

Failure accounting distinguishes pre allocation becoming failures from post allocation invalid failures with separate counters and byte totals, scaling the latter and including compressed length when compression support is active.

The global module mutex serializes reservation, duplicate checks, debug finalization, state promotion to coming, usage link traversal and teardown unlink with waiter wakeup. Readers use read copy update list traversal and teardown waits for a grace period before freeing list membership.

A dedicated spinlock guards a hashed set of in progress idempotent cookies. Insertion determines first versus waiter, and completion removes every entry with the same cookie, stores one shared result and wakes all waiters.
Each module owns a parameter mutex initialized once permanent storage is allocated and before parameters become visible through parsing or system directory files.
Address tree registration iterates every memory type, back links each node to its owner and inserts only non empty regions into a latch ordered tree through a non inlined helper.
An idempotent waiter records an opaque cookie, hash linkage, a completion event and a shared integer result, allowing concurrent callers with identical cookies to collapse onto one execution.

System directory initialization fails when the module set is absent and rejects duplicate names after dropping the extra reference, otherwise zeroes the object, attaches the set and adds the named object with cleanup on failure.

Registration, hardening, version, signature, statistics, system directory and parameter lock helpers are exposed for use across the module subsystem, with hardening split by text, read only data and data execute policy.

Signature check and verification, enforcement query, statistics bumps, system directory setup and parameter lock initialization form the cross file service surface used by the load pipeline and teardown.

Blacklisted names, duplicate system directory entries, enforced unsigned images, hardening errors, coming notification vetoes and argument errors each abort the load and drive the module to going with notifier, debug, tracing, architecture, info and unload cleanup in the correct order.
Idempotent cookie hash width is eight bits, defining a 256 bucket table for collapsing concurrent identical requests.
Section attributes use octal mode 0400 and note attributes use octal mode 0444, with section reads bounded and note reads sized by section length.
